name.full: PSA N2N OEN voyage performance (API + UI)

description.short: PSA OEN voyages, risk and recovery via API as you.
description.full: Answers PSA N2N OEN voyage questions - listings, at-risk voyages, worst and recovery nodes, recovery levers - using the OEN API through an Azure API Management MCP server that calls OEN as the signed-in user with their linked OEN account. Falls back to the OEN browser UI for CSV export and UI-only fields.

agentConnectors.description: PSA OEN voyage tools (list_voyages, get_voyage, get_voyage_nodes), run as the signed-in user.
